post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Economics in the Centre for Budget Studies

qualification.details: Assistant Professor - Economics: Economics in the Centre for Budget Studies

how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal of Cochin University of Science and Technology.
Access the online registration link for the Assistant Professor recruitment under notification number Ad.D2/Tenure Appointments/CBS/2026.
Complete the online submission before the deadline of 24-10-2026.
Pay the required application fee based on your candidate category (INR 950 for General, INR 195 for SC/ST, and NA for Foreign candidates).
Take a printout of the submitted application and send the hardcopy to reach the designated office on or before 31-10-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment notification number for the CUSAT Assistant Professor post?

faq.question: Q8. Is the appointment regular or on contract?
